update.researcher_instruction: "Commit and push the OT-97.37 weave, then read OT-97.38 (M72) and tell me the impact." then "the M72 ruling was premature, and the reread highlight the additional contribution these verses make.  continue with the weaving in the narrative" (2026-10-18)
update.method: The seven M18 x M72 forward verses (Gen 31:29, 1Sa 15:28, Ezr 7:9, Ezr 8:18, Neh 2:8, Neh 2:18, Isa 52:7) and the pointer 1Ki 2:15 read in their passages for the act that moves in each (rule 73), not for M72's role. Woven: Ezr 7:10 (10.7 Setting the heart), Ezr 7:28 with 8:22 (10.12 What changes it), Neh 2:17-18 (10.10), 1Sa 15:26-28 (13.1 Ruling), Isa 52:7-9 (13.1 Ruling, new paragraph), the good hand Ezr 7:6, 9; 8:18, 22; Neh 2:8 (13.1 Delight, new paragraph His good hand). Rule 77 reconciliation: no current claim is told in the touched passages on these concepts; none untold. Not woven: Gen 31:29 (stays on OT-98.4 for M58), 1Sa 15:30 (forward to M22), the strengthened hands of Neh 2:18 (forward to M23), 1Ki 2:15-22 (forward to M20 / 10.11).
update.claims_changed_note: Six new claims (Ezra's heart set and the good hand; courage on knowing God's hand; resolve given by another's telling; the kingdom taken answering a rejected word; God's reign with wrath and as good news; the good hand named as the reason).
update.quote_note: every new quotation checked against iba.db verse (ESV)
update.notes: The researcher called the #1998 M72 scope ruling premature (2026-10-18); the question of the other set-aside M72 verses is #2161.

new.text: Ezra's heart set to study the Law, to do it and to teach it is given straight after the good hand of God on him, as its ground in him
new.beyond_text: reads the second 'For' of Ezra 7:10 as giving the hand of 7:9 its ground in Ezra's heart

new.text: Knowing that God's hand is on him is the named ground of Ezra's courage, and the courage turns at once into a deed
new.beyond_text: joins Ezra 7:28 to his refusal of the king's soldiers (8:22) as fear's change

new.text: What one person tells of God's dealing with him can give others resolve
new.beyond_text: reads 'strengthened their hands' as resolve taken, and sets it beside Ezra's own courage on the same ground

new.text: God's taking of the kingdom from Saul answers Saul's rejection of his word, in the same word
new.beyond_text: sets 'rejected' (15:26) beside the torn kingdom (15:28) and the torn robe (15:27)

new.text: God's reign is spoken with wrath in one place, and as good news with peace, salvation and comfort in another
Those on whom God's good hand rests name it as the reason for what came about, and it is said to be for good on all who seek him
new.beyond_text: gathers the 'good hand' sayings of Ezra and Nehemiah into one account of God's favor
